title: Pagination totals computed from paginated result; count query never executed
description: Verified: api/crud/get.ps1:48 sets $totalItems = $rs.Count, but $rs is the already-paginated result (query at get.ps1:41 applies LIMIT @pageSize OFFSET @offset). So $totalItems never exceeds pageSize (default 10). The correct count query $countSqlx is built (get.ps1:21,39) but never executed. Consequently totalPages, endIndex, hasNextPage, and the page-number list (get.ps1:52-63) are all wrong and pagination past page 1 is broken.
notes_resolution: Resolved via deletion per approval (.aidd/responses.md: the feature/tag demo domain is discarded, Pantry is modeled fresh). The buggy api/crud/get.ps1 — where $totalItems = $rs.Count read the already-paginated result and the built $countSqlx was never executed — was removed with the demo CRUD routes in commit 02323cb. A repo-wide grep confirms no totalItems/$countSqlx/hasNextPage/totalPages logic remains in source; the only surviving paging code is api/_lib/crud-paging.ps1, a pure input-parser with no total-count computation. The pantry views (inventory/lowstock/expiring) are grouped/derived projections, not paginated, so there is no total-count surface. Spec step 4's pagination Pester test is moot under deletion; the existing suite (56 passed / 0 failed) covers the surviving paging-input helper. Refreshed the stale §6 FACT in .aidd/assertions.md.
notes: Coupling: mutates the api/crud/get.ps1 paging block (get.ps1:48-63) and adds tests/*.ps1 alongside remediation-20260710-paging-input-validation (which fixes the get.ps1:13-14 int cast) — distinct defects on the same file/test surface; sequence them to avoid an edit collision. Caveat: get.ps1 may be superseded by audit-codebase-analysis-1783691795-data-model-mismatch; sequence after the salvage-vs-rewrite decision. | Added by feature-review 2026-07-10.
spec:
Detailed remediation steps:
1. Execute the already-built $countSqlx with the same WHERE parameters (tagFilter/search) but without pageSize/offset.
2. Set $totalItems from the scalar count result (e.g. (Invoke-SqliteQuery ... ).count).
3. Recompute totalPages/endIndex/hasNextPage/pages from that value.
4. Add a Pester test seeding > pageSize rows and asserting totalItems and hasNextPage are correct on page 1.

approval.decision: Approved. Per .aidd/responses.md: the feature/tag demo domain is discarded � resolve this finding by deleting the demo code path as Pantry is modeled fresh, not by patching it.
